correctness.rationale: Fixing all but one tree-edge increment yields strictly convex variance coefficient mu(descendant)(1-mu(descendant)), forcing saturation. For an entire arm, every pair coefficient a_k(1-a_j)ell_j ell_k is positive, and the sole exterior-field coefficients have common sign; this proves every arm has constant signed full slope and excludes all other maxima. Signed radial potentials are 1-Lipschitz, and variance equals R-(sum eps_i q_i)^2. Exact rational exhaustive enumeration on 180 heterogeneous samples and 16 balanced-arm instances independently checks boundary and equality behavior; a direct polynomial binary-input reduction supplies the NP-complete threshold.

value.rationale: The formula determines the exact Lipschitz-to-centered-Hilbert operator norm across a natural, nontrivial infinite family of tree metrics with arbitrary positive lengths and probabilities. It proves complete optimizer rigidity, moment-profile invariance, a parity effect for balanced spiders, and a weakly NP-complete sharp star threshold. This is structural information not obtained by a direct fixed-size table or by renaming a standard variance bound.
